hypotheses.latent_object: T(alpha,beta,gamma,form) = F(alpha*(beta+gamma)) if form=factored else F(alpha*beta+alpha*gamma)
hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate T with alpha=x, beta=y, gamma=z. Selecting form=factored returns the first F-term, and selecting form=expanded returns the second F-term.
required_assumptions: F is a unary function applied to syntactically distinct algebraic forms.
hypotheses.rationale: The two F-terms are generated by a single parameterized distributive template; the only difference is the syntactic form of the argument.

hypotheses.latent_object: F(p) where p is the common polynomial value of x*(y+z) and x*y+x*z under distributivity
hypotheses.construction_plan: Set p = x*y + x*z as the expanded representative. The expanded F-term is the identity image of F(p). The factored F-term is obtained by the distributive rewrite/representation specialization x*y+x*z -> x*(y+z) inside the argument of F.
required_assumptions: Distributivity of multiplication over addition for x,y,z.
proof_obligations: F(x*(y + z)) - F(x*y + x*z) = 0 for the common argument p
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical terms are confluent syntactic representatives of the same polynomial argument to F, so a single latent polynomial explains both.
